artworks.title: Anticlea in the Underworld
artworks.description: A nineteenth-century illustration returns to Odyssey 11: Anticleia among the shades — Odysseus' mother, dead of longing, speaking to her living son at the trench of blood.

films.title: Ulysses
films.description: Camerini's epic keeps the Nekyia among Odysseus' trials — Anticleia's underworld greeting as the cost of the long return.

films.title: The Odyssey
films.description: Konchalovsky's miniseries restages the meeting with the dead — Anticleia among the shades who tell Odysseus what Ithaca has become.
